Priya (design): quick critique round for the Create Dataset form. two open items: 1) error surfacing on dense multi-row forms  inline per-field vs. condensed summary? 2) required-field affordance: only asterisk, or explicit 'Required' text?
Luca (pm): For power users with big uploads, a top summary + anchors makes scanning easier. But for single-item flows inline immediate feedback is nicer.
Chen (eng): Performance note: hundreds of inline error nodes spike layout passes. We could lazy-initialize inline messages when a row is focused or when errors are interacted with.
Marta (a11y): Asterisk alone isn't reliably announced. Recommend visible "Required" tied with aria-describedby or aria-required and a short legend explaining the marker. Also add aria-live="polite" to the summary on submit.
Priya (design): Copy nits: current error "Missing name" -> propose "Please enter a name for this dataset." short + actionable. For the summary header options: "We found X issues" vs "Please fix these errors"  thoughts?
Luca (pm): "We found X issues" is neutral and feels less blaming.
Chen (eng): For destructive actions (delete dataset): typed confirm for irreversible deletes, undo toast for accidental deletes when we have soft restores. Typed confirm needs robust focus/labeling.
Marta (a11y): If typed confirm is used, ensure the instruction phrase is clear and the SR sees the confirmation requirement. Avoid trapping focus without announcing context.
Priya (design): Proposed pattern: default to compact summary with count + anchor links after submit. Inline messages remain available but rendered lazily on focus. Required marker: show asterisk visually + visually-hidden "Required" text programmatically linked. Tooltip on hover for sighted users.
Luca (pm): Sounds good. Let's run a quick moderated test with 6 internal users (3 power, 3 novice) to validate discoverability.
Chen (eng): I'll prototype lazy rendering and measure reflow with 250 rows.
Marta (a11y): I'll test NVDA/VoiceOver keyboard flows once the prototype is up. Remember to include skip-to-errors and non-disruptive announcements.
Priya (design): Poll: react with :one: for inline-eager, :two: for summary-first (summary then inline-on-focus).
RedwoodBot: New reactions added. :eyes:
Luca (pm): :two:
Chen (eng): :one:
Marta (a11y): :two:
Priya (design): majority looks summary-first. I'll upload mocks for both patterns and a short prototype by EOD. Tagging @Chen for feasibility and @Marta for a11y signoff.
